## Prerequisites and Configuration Guide
### Before you begin, ensure that you have a NKP cluster running Kubernetes version >= 1.35
### Kserve requires the following applications to be installed on the NKP cluster:
- cert-manager >= v1.19.3
- envoy-gateway v1.8.1
